definitions.ask: Should the release workflow pin maturin to 1.16.0, the version that built the 0.43.1 artifacts?
definitions.why: The tag-order-independent matcher removes this failure class; a pin is one more manual bump

choices.label: Builds keep the newest maturin 1.x from pyproject; the unused MATURIN_VERSION line is deleted
Release builds stay on maturin 1.16.0 until someone bumps MATURIN_VERSION by hand
